effect.name: Hit Flash
effect.description: The damage flash. Drives the sprite to a solid colour and back without touching its silhouette, so a hit reads instantly even at 160x144.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Flash Colour
parameter.description: Colour the sprite flashes to. White for a generic hit, red for damage taken, dark green to read on a DMG screen.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: How far through the flash you are. Animate this, leave everything else alone.

parameter.name: Additive
parameter.description: On, the colour is added on top so bright pixels blow out. Off, the sprite is blended toward the colour.

parameter.name: Alpha Fade
parameter.description: Fades the sprite out as it flashes. Handy for death pops: run Amount and this together.
